title: Part Library search, filters, sorting and columns still work
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [User-A], Admin role.
  • Location: [Loc-1], any one location [User-A] can pick in the location selector in the top bar.
  • Browser: a desktop browser window at least 1280 pixels wide (parts management is desktop and tablet only).
  • Data: 2 Part Library entries with no manufacturer: [PN-A] ("ZZAUTOTEST PL lib list Alpha", [Cat-1]) and [PN-B] ("ZZAUTOTEST PL lib list Bravo", [Cat-2]); part numbers ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LIBLIST-01 and -02 (examples).

Setup

  1. Sign in as [User-A] and pick [Loc-1] in the location selector in the top bar.
  2. [Cat-1] and [Cat-2] = two different categories from the Category list.
  3. Create [PN-A]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL lib list Alpha" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LIBLIST-01 (examples), pick [Cat-1], type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [PN-A] = the part number you typed.
  4. Create [PN-B]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL lib list Bravo" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LIBLIST-02 (examples), pick [Cat-2], type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [PN-B] = the part number you typed.
  5. Check the setup worked: Parts → Part Library searched for ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LIBLIST lists 2 entries.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  2. Read the column headers.
  3. Type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LIBLIST in the Search box.
  4. Open the Category filter and pick [Cat-1].
  5. Open the Category filter and pick All categories.
  6. Open the Manufacturer filter and pick any manufacturer.
  7. Open the Manufacturer filter and pick All manufacturers.
  8. Click the Description column header.
  9. Click the Description column header again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The columns are Description, Part Number, Tags, Category, Manufacturer, Measurement and Size, as on the earlier build.
  • Step 3: Search works: [PN-A] and [PN-B] are listed (2 rows).
  • Step 4: The Category filter works: only [PN-A] is listed.
  • Step 5: Both are listed again.
  • Step 6: The Manufacturer filter works: neither entry is listed, because neither has a manufacturer.
  • Step 7: Both are listed again.
  • Steps 8 and 9: Sorting works: the entries are ordered by Description, and the second click reverses the order.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S11-R5, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas board 7.1 (Part Library), board 7.0 (Before: the Catalog page today).
